source_issues.title: Zero-init/symmetry generalization
source_issues.evidence_and_boundary: Equal weights alone do not establish every claimed update symmetry without matching biases/downstream structure. Neuron counts are not parameter counts; forward symmetry demonstration does not prove one effective trainable parameter.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; no required edit

source_issues.title: Fixed-depth infinity/learnability claims
source_issues.evidence_and_boundary: EXPLODED is a display threshold; original default random-normal ReLU values remain finite in the displayed50-layer run. No universal layer20 overflow or layer3 success established.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful source retained; no required edit

source_issues.title: Variance formula omits assumptions
